resources.string: Screen Assist reads a one-time visible-text or icon-control snapshot only after you arm it in Nexa. It excludes password and edit fields, keeps results temporarily in memory, and never taps or sends data to AI automatically.

Only after you tap Find GitHub icon, Nexa inspects the default launcher to look for the GitHub label and can swipe horizontally up to eight times. Never clicks or reads inside other apps. Disable anytime in Android Accessibility settings.
